speaker: wil_wheaton
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You betrayed me, Wil Wheaton. Now I have my revenge.

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: You went to the'95 Dixie-Trek? Oh, dude, my grandmother had just died, and I had to go to her funeral.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Your mee-maw died? That's terrible.

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: Yeah, it was. But I'm really sorry that I disappointed you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, no, I understand. Anything happened to my mee-maw, I'd be one inconsolable moon pie. I should clarify that statement by explaining that she calls me moon pie.

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: It's special relationship, isn't it, between a boy and his grandmother?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, yes.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Okay, great, everybody loves their grandmas! Now, come on, Sheldon, finish him off!

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: It's okay, Sheldon. I let you down. I deserve it. Potion of Zancor.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What are you waiting for? Kill Wil Wheaton! From hell's heart, stab at him!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I can't.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Sure you can. Do it! Do it!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No. I came here to defeat Wil Wheaton, the man who destroyed my dreams. But I can't defeat Wil Wheaton, the man who loved his mee-maw. Enchanted bunny.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: No! Not enchanted bunny!

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: I call my mee-maw nana. And she's going be very happy to hear that my small rock kills your enchanted bunny. Game over, moon pie.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I... I... I don't understand. Your grandmother's alive?

speaker: wil_wheaton
text: Oh, you catch on quick. Come on, Stewie, let's get our prize money.

text: That was fun.
